description: This file defines a custom Akka mailbox class 'PolicyPersistenceActorMailbox' for handling policy modification commands with capacity-based rejection logic, including an inner class implementing the message queue behavior.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorMailbox
classes.description: Custom Akka mailbox class that manages policy modification commands with capacity constraints.

classes.name: PolicyPersistenceActorMessageQueue
classes.description: Inner class implementing the message queue with capacity-based rejection for PolicyModifyCommand messages.

methods.name: PolicyPersistenceActorMailbox
methods.description: Constructor initializing mailbox capacity from config.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new message queue instance.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues messages, handling PolicyModifyCommand with capacity check.

methods.name: enqueueFirst
methods.description: Enqueues messages at the front, handling PolicyModifyCommand with capacity check.

methods.name: queueSizeBasedAction
methods.description: Performs capacity check and either runs the provided Runnable or sends a rejection response.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the next message from the queue.

methods.name: numberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns the current number of messages in the queue.

methods.name: hasMessages
methods.description: Checks if the queue has any messages.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Clears the queue, enqueuing messages to dead letters.
